ORDER ACKNOWLEDGMENT
Aperture Sensors LLC

Re: Buyer PO RIDGE-PO-2024-1187 dated June 20, 2024.

Aperture Sensors LLC acknowledges receipt of the above purchase order and
confirms the following:

Line 1: 250 units VS-4200 vibration sensors, $412.00 per unit — CONFIRMED.
Line 2: 250 units VS-4200 mounting brackets, $38.00 per unit — CONFIRMED.
Line 3: On-site calibration service, $8,400 — CONFIRMED, subject to site

Estimated ship date: August 5, 2024 (fourteen (14) days later than Buyer's
requested delivery date, due to a two-week backlog on the VS-4200 line).

3. Seller's total liability under any order is limited to the price paid for

4. Any dispute arising out of or relating to this order shall be resolved by

5. This acknowledgment, together with the referenced PO, is the complete
